name: pc-cohort-builder
description: Generates a cohort from an ATLAS cohort definition (Circe JSON) or OHDSI SQL in each node's OMOP CDM database and returns the subject count per node. Run generate_cohort (data extraction) and then cohort_count (federated) in the same session.

functions.name: generate_cohort
functions.description: Generate a cohort in this node's OMOP database and leave its subject count in the session.

arguments.name: sql
arguments.description: OHDSI CohortGenerator SQL. Provide exactly one of sql or atlas_json.

arguments.name: atlas_json
arguments.description: ATLAS cohort expression (Circe JSON). Provide exactly one of sql or atlas_json.

arguments.name: cohort_id
arguments.description: Positive cohort identifier. Generated from the current time if omitted; use the same id at every node.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Replace an existing cohort with the same id instead of failing.

databases.name: omop
databases.description: The node's OMOP CDM database. Its env settings must give DBMS, USER, PASSWORD, CDM_DATABASE, CDM_SCHEMA and RESULTS_SCHEMA.

functions.name: cohort_count
functions.description: Return the cohort outcome generate_cohort recorded at this node: status, cohort id and subject count.

databases.name: cohort
databases.description: The one-row dataframe generate_cohort left in the session.
